Dear Store,

I am complaining about a product in my recent order that was defective and did not function as described upon opening the box, failing to meet quality standards.

This issue directly affects my usage and experience. I hope to receive a prompt response and resolution.

I have compiled all relevant evidence, including images showing the product defect, order information, and other necessary details, into this document:

https://ln.run/FullDocumentationofFaultyProductandOrderDetails

I kindly request that the store investigate and assist in resolving this issue, prioritizing product exchange or an equivalent solution according to the store's policy.

Hello Jorge,

Could you please provide us with your order number so we can take the necessary steps, as well as the name of the defective item in your order?

The link you provided does not work.

Thank you for your response.

Chaleureusement,

Hari
